verdict.rationale: Copilot's docs describe agents that autonomously "plan, explore, and execute work" (docs-3), an agent mode that works on workspace files (docs-2), and an editor assistant that explains concepts (docs-22). Docs-9 also mentions shared context drawn from repositories. Together these imply the agent can explore a codebase without hand-picked context, but nothing documents mapping or explaining an entire unfamiliar codebase. Missing for 10: explicit whole-repo indexing or automatic context retrieval, a documented codebase-explanation or architecture-mapping workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
